categories.main_business_segments: The company operates as a large comprehensive insurance financial group with primary segments including property insurance (via PICC Property and Casualty), life insurance (via PICC Life), health insurance (via PICC Health), asset management (via PICC Asset Management), pension services (via PICC Pension), real estate and elderly care management (via PICC Investment Holdings), alternative investments (via PICC Capital), reinsurance (via PICC Reinsurance), technology services (via PICC Technology), and financial services (via PICC Financial Services).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced information technology including data mining, customer insights, intelligent operations, and AI capabilities with over 170 general AI functions. It emphasizes digital transformation through unified cloud platforms, multi-cloud and multi-core architectures, and intelligent risk control platforms. The group also develops innovative insurance products such as technology insurance, green insurance, and digital economy insurance, supported by a comprehensive digital infrastructure and smart service platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including individual policyholders, small and medium enterprises, agricultural producers, high-tech and specialized enterprises, and government entities. It covers diverse markets such as motor vehicle insurance, agricultural insurance, health and life insurance, corporate property insurance, and specialized insurance for emerging sectors like new energy vehicles and technology enterprises. The company also supports social insurance schemes and pension plans, serving nearly one billion people in health-related insurance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across mainland China with a nationwide presence, including urban and rural areas. It also has significant operations in Hong Kong and Macau through its subsidiary PICC Hong Kong. Its international footprint includes global reinsurance networks covering over 80 countries and regions, and it supports Chinese enterprises' overseas projects. Key provinces with high business volumes include Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shandong, and Hebei.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the downstream segment of the insurance and financial services supply chain, providing insurance products and services directly to end customers. It also manages upstream asset management and investment activities to support its insurance liabilities and capital requirements. Additionally, it engages in reinsurance activities to manage risk exposure and collaborates with reinsurers and financial institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include high-quality development aligned with national strategies, innovation in insurance products (e.g., technology, green, and catastrophe insurance), digital transformation, and risk management enhancement. The company focuses on expanding technology insurance, green finance, and inclusive insurance coverage, while strengthening asset-liability management and cost efficiency. R&D efforts emphasize AI, big data, cloud computing, and intelligent risk control to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through insurance premium income from property, life, health, and pension insurance products. Additional revenue streams include investment income from asset management activities, fees from pension and alternative investment services, and technology service fees within the group. The company also earns underwriting profits and investment returns on insurance funds.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's insurance industry, ranking first in property insurance market share (31.8%) and holding significant shares in life and health insurance markets. It competes with other major Chinese insurance groups and international insurers operating in China. Its strong brand, extensive network, and diversified business model position it as a top-tier comprehensive insurance financial group domestically.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 622 billion in 2024, representing a 12.5% year-over-year increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.77 trillion, growing 13.4% from the prior year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 42.87 billion, an 88.2% increase. The company maintains strong solvency ratios and has demonstrated steady growth in premiums, investment income, and asset management scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its long-standing brand heritage as the first national insurance company in China, comprehensive product offerings, and integration of policy and commercial insurance. It differentiates through advanced technology adoption, extensive nationwide service networks, strong risk management capabilities, and commitment to social responsibility. Its focus on innovation in technology insurance, green insurance, and inclusive insurance products provides unique value to customers and supports national strategic goals.
